label: Custom Code
help: Your own HTML, CSS and JavaScript
trust_warning: Paste only code you trust. It runs on the website for every visitor. Every save and publish of this code is recorded in Security Center.
html_help: Buttons, boxes, embeds (YouTube, Google Map, forms). <script> tags inside HTML also run.
js_help: Runs after the HTML is on the page. Write plain code, without <script> tags.
preview_note: The editor preview shows this section in safe mode. Scripts run, but clicking selects the section. Use Preview for a full test before Publish.
mode_isolated_help: The code runs in its own box. It cannot read the visitor's login, cart or prices and cannot change the rest of the page. Links open in a new tab.
mode_inline_help: The code is placed straight into the page and can change anything on it. Use this only for widgets that must work with the page. Prices, discounts and orders are still checked again by the server.
site_warning: Runs on every storefront page for every visitor. Paste only code from sources you trust (Facebook Pixel, Google Tag Manager, chat widget). Every change is recorded in Security Center.
site_head_help: Meta tags, verification tags, tracking scripts, fonts.
site_body_help: Chat widgets, <noscript> tags, scripts that need the page loaded.
site_note: Active on the live website after Publish (not inside this editor preview). Turn the switch off and Publish to stop it at once.
